intent: A six-digit verification code card that feels physical: digits roll in, paste ripples, wrong codes shake away cell by cell, and success sweeps light across the cells before they fuse into one Verified pill. Dark and monochrome: the card rises from blur and its contents, cell by cell, stagger in.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (container queries); one PALETTE (dark + light) → --otp-* CSS variables
stack.animation: motion/react; useScheduler (timeouts + rAF cancelled on unmount), useImperative (keyframe shakes stopped on unmount), useOtpField (selection, paste merge, keys), useCooldown
stack.input: one transparent native input over aria-hidden cells

layout.card: max-width 400px, radius 20px, surface + inset hairline + deep shadow, padding 36/32/32 from 384px container up, 28/24/24 below
layout.order: channel tile → heading → lead-in + destination + Edit → cells → 42px status line → hairline → resend row (44px) → footnote
layout.cells: flex-1, 52px tall (56px ≥384px container), radius 12px, 8px gaps, 16–20px gap between the two groups of three
layout.code: AuthOtp orchestrates phases; CodeRow (input over cells + VerifiedPill), Cell, DestinationLine + DestinationEditor, StatusLine, ResendButton

color.approach: monochrome; one accent prop (default = theme ink) for the active-cell ring, caret, Send and the emphasised Resend; colour only for meaning: error and the success sweep/pill

dark.success: #3ddc97 ring 50%, 7% fill, digits #c9f7e1; pill = 12% success mixed into the surface, 45% ring, 4px 6% halo

motion.activeCell: shared layoutId ring, spring stiffness 500 damping 40
motion.caret: 2×22px bar, 1.06s stepped blink, only while focused and on an empty cell
motion.digits: each digit settles: y 60%→0, scale .86→1, blur 4→0 over 300ms ease-out; exits upward; per-cell change stamps so repeats still roll
motion.paste: 45ms stagger from the paste point; each cell lifts 4px
motion.error: cells shake x 0,−6,5,−3,2,0 over 400ms with 45ms stagger, tint coral, then digits exit upward with 30ms stagger and focus returns to cell 1
motion.success: 80% band of pale green light crosses each cell (340ms linear, 55ms stagger) → cells slide by barLeft + i·w − offsetLeft into one bar, inner corners square, digits blur out (260ms in-out) → pill at the bar's size animates to 188×48 r24 (460ms in-out), check draws, 'Verified' fades in
motion.resend: countdown digits roll; wait → Resend code → Sending… → Sent ✓ → new 30s countdown
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades only; no rolls, shakes, sweep or glide; pill appears directly
motion.entrance: once at 30% in view: card y 16→0 + blur 10→0 (600ms); glyph → heading → destination 50ms apart from 120ms; then each cell rises 12px out of a 6px blur, 35ms apart; then status line, resend row, footnote
motion.cleanup: every setTimeout and requestAnimationFrame goes through useScheduler and is cancelled on unmount; imperative shakes, nudges and ripples are stopped on unmount

responsive.390px: cells 52px tall and ~44px wide, card padding 24px

accessibility: single input: inputMode=numeric, autocomplete=one-time-code, pattern=[0-9]*, maxLength=6, labelled '6-digit verification code'
aria-describedby points at the destination line and the status line
arrows, Home, End, Backspace, Delete and Enter all behave per cell
Edit is a real button labelled 'Edit email address'; inline editor validates, Esc cancels
focus-visible: 2px #ededef outline offset 2px; buttons press at .97

content.heading: Check your inbox
content.hint: Paste the whole code into any box.
content.footnote: Codes last 10 minutes. Not there? Check spam — it’s shy.
errors: That code didn’t match. 2 tries left.
That code has expired. Send yourself a fresh one.
Too many wrong codes. Request a new one to keep going.
content.result: onVerify resolves {ok:true} | {ok:false, reason:'invalid', attemptsLeft} | {ok:false, reason:'expired'} | {ok:false, reason:'locked'}
content.demo: 314159 verifies, 000000 is expired, three misses lock; Copy pill to try paste

avoid: visible native caret or selection highlight
confetti, sparkles or glow bursts on success
replacing the cells with a spinner while verifying
clearing the code on a network error
rAF or timeouts that outlive the component
